evidence.V1: Classic cross-hilt reads clearly in front, three-quarter and silhouette (pointed blade, flared guard, round pommel); top view is just a guard bar with the blade diamond, which is still the expected sword read. No correctness caps: A15 X/Y error 0.0, guard and gem offsets 0.0, all seats seated with no gap.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big = long steel blade, medium = flared gold guard with central boss, small = teal gem, banded grip wraps, pommel collar and ball.
evidence.V3: Guard and pommel are chunky and stylised, but the blade is a parallel-sided slab with a short stubby tip and no taper or ricasso, and the guard is a flat plank; reads partly stiff rather than confidently exaggerated.
evidence.V4: Guard has even chamfers that catch light along its top and flared ends, but blade cheeks meet the fuller and the edge strips at hard creases, and the pommel collar is a sharp-edged plain cylinder; bevels are inconsistent across parts.
evidence.V5: No patches, seams or z-fighting in close-ups and A17/A18 are clean, but the pommel ball shows a visibly polygonal outline and stepped shading in the pommel studio close-up (low-segment sphere).
evidence.V6: Disciplined: gold accent, two steel greys plus a darker fuller value, and one hue (teal) in two values on gem and wraps; colourways swap only that hue.
evidence.V7: 2476 tris vs weapon target 2500 (ceiling 4000): at target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold/steel/one-hue palette and guard chamfer size match the kit swords; smooth shading consistent apart from the faceted pommel.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Tool Handle at grip point, CollisionFidelity Hull, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white for vertex colours, SmoothPlastic.

artifacts: Pommel ball faceted: polygonal outline and stepped shading visible in pommel studio close-up
Pommel collar is a hard-edged cylinder with no chamfer (edge-treatment inconsistency rather than a shading defect)
top_fixes: Give the blade a gentle taper toward the tip (and/or a short ricasso) and lengthen the point so it reads less like a parallel slab
Raise pommel sphere segment count or add a support loop so its outline and shading are smooth
Apply the kit ~0.045-stud chamfer to the blade's outer edges, fuller creases and the pommel collar rims so bevels are consistent with the guard
Add a slight curve or downward droop to the guard arms to push the stylisation beyond a flat plank
